column3: if - The Abominable Kirino Chapter
Anyways!  This time, you go over there and wait.
Y-Yeah...
In the end, I'm waiting while Kirino shops again...
How did it get like this...
*sigh*...
After this, it would be great if I didn't meet anyone else, but...
Oh?  This is most unexpected!
Ah...
Eh?
I turned towards the sudden voices that surprised me.
As I did, I saw Kuroneko and Saori standing there.
W-What are these guys doing...?!
Y-Yo. How's it going?
Fufufu. I am accompanying Kuroneko-shi today.
Is that so?  Oh, was there something going on?
There isn't really anything.
Kuroneko-shi? Is that okay?
Ahh, this is that "Hey Listen!" time, isn't it?
I should obediently listen to their story.
I wanna know, I wanna know. What is it?
Today, Unabara was supposed to appear at the arcade.
Unabara...?
Unabara-shi is a famous, highly skilled gamer in the world of fighting games! His skill is such that he is even well known in foreign tournaments.
His personal let's play videos have been viewed more than 300,000 times.
That's incredible.
I came to see what this lowly human who is said to have such skill is made of.
Ahh, if you had the chance you were going to challenge him or something.
I didn't say that exactly.
Haven't you been acting a bit restless since earlier?
Even you are joining in now?
As the easily predictable Kuroneko looked away, Saori and I unconsciously looked at each other and held back a chuckle.
It seemed that she was really anticipating the challenge.
Speaking of which...
Oh?  What is it?
What are you doing, Kyousuke-shi?
Urgh...
If I truthfully say that I'm attending to Kirino, it would be bad.
Yesterday, Kirino even turned down those two's invitation to go shopping.
A-Ah, yeah, I'm, how to put it... shopping?
Do those large bags there contain the goods you wanted?
T-That's right! A-- Aha ha ha ha.
Good gracious...!  They're all brands for women's goods.
Huh?! Thaaaat is....
Oh no!  Those are Kirino's bags!
W-What kind of excuse can I...
This is... this is... that's...
Aha～h!  Kyousuke-shi... don't tell me...
This is bad.  Am I exposed...?
Are you doing that recently popular thing... Playing a trap?
...Huh?
Even boys have been caught up in feeling and dressing up like a girl, taking pictures or joining events to have masculine guys select them...
Kyousuke-shi, you have your ear to the ground as always!
K-Kuroneko looks appalled!
B-But I can't just say this isn't true... Augh!
T-That's right!  That's why I bought all of this!  HA... HAHAHAHA--
Wouldn't it have been better if you had mail ordered over the internet?
That you actually bought them in person...
T-That's right!  That is right!  HA HA HA HA HA!
Nothing left to lose now!  Who cares what happens next!
But, that you would have an interest in playing a trap is...
Not only being a siscon but this... how low you have sunk...
Speaking of which Kuroneko-shi, Kyousuke-shi was pretty excited about cosplaying before...
In other words, he loves cosplay?
That's a possibility.
Somehow, the conversation is headed in an undesirable...
Ohhhh man!  I wanna run away as soon as I can!
By the way, Kyousuke-shi...
Y-Yes?!
If you're dressing up as a trap, you'll definitely have a photo session, right?
Huh?  Ummmmm...
Of course you'll be taking pictures, right? Since you're dressing up as a trap.
Ah... Ahhh, ahaha... When I can dress up well, I may let you take it then!
As I thought!  Well then, when that time comes, please send us the pictures too!
W-What?!?!
Yes. It won't be disagreeable to see your ridiculous appearance.
And so it goes, don't forget to send Kuroneko-shi and I the pictures.
Y-Yeah...
Those two look like they're really enjoying this.
This is... a complete misunderstanding!
N-No! I can't let this excuse go on...
U-Um, you guys...
Oops!  This isn't the time to be talking.  Unabara-shi coming here is the more important matter!
Indeed.  Though a mere human, letting one with that much skill escape from my senses would be most troubling.
Very well then, Kyousuke-shi.  We will be going.
We'll be looking forward to the pictures.
Yeah...
The two of them left with a complete misunderstanding.
There's no way to fix this situation any more...
Auugghhhh...
Why are you sweating so much?
This is not a story that could be told with few words...
Huh? Turning blue and sweating so much... Weren't you just fooling around by yourself too much?
